data.title: Why Bitcoin Is Down Today
data.description: Hackers just drained $6.3 billion from Binance in the largest crypto theft on record, and while the exchange says it will cover every loss, it's another reminder that crypto is still more Wild West than most traditional investors are comfortable with.
